neighbours.label: the word 'susceptible' (being liable to be affected by something), as against near synonyms and neutral predicates in the same frame
fire: Older trees are more susceptible to the fungus than young ones.
The design is also susceptible to timing attacks on the server.
Children under five are especially susceptible to dehydration.
This variety of wheat is highly susceptible to rust in wet years.
The estimate is susceptible to bias when samples are small.
Many coastal towns are susceptible to flooding during spring tides.
People who sleep badly may be more susceptible to colds.
The old wooden bridge was susceptible to rot after every winter.
quiet: Older trees are more resistant to the fungus than young ones.
The design is also tested against timing attacks on the server.
Children under five are especially fond of bright colours.
This variety of wheat grows well even in wet years.
The estimate is reliable even when samples are small.
Many coastal towns are popular with tourists during spring tides.
People who sleep badly may be more tired in the morning.
The old wooden bridge was repainted after every winter.
